# Responsive UI and Tailwind Rules

- Design mobile-first and add only purposeful breakpoints.
- Distinguish viewport queries from container-size needs.
- Prevent overflow with correct flex/grid minimum sizes and wrapping.
- Use semantic design tokens instead of hardcoded palette values.
- Keep light/dark tokens semantically named across themes.
- Verify requested responsive behavior at representative desktop, tablet, and mobile sizes.
